response.justification: The candidate is a strong, versatile senior engineer, but their profile does not match this role's core requirements. Professional C++ experience is limited to a ~7-month stint at National Instruments in 2014–2015 (plus a thesis project), far short of the mandated 5–10 years of hands-on C++ on Windows. There is no Fixed Income, capital markets, or investment banking domain experience — RIDE Capital was a fintech startup but not capital markets — and no evidence of deep SQL Server/Oracle work or Summit platform exposure. Recent work is TypeScript/Node.js full-stack, making this a poor fit despite solid engineering fundamentals.
strengths: Strong systems-programming fundamentals (low-latency DLang services, some C/C++ background)
Solid engineering practices: TDD, CI/CD, DevOps, and messaging/event-driven architectures
Fluent English communication with demonstrated teaching, workshops, and conference talks
concerns: Only ~7 months of professional C++ experience, and it dates back to 2015
No Fixed Income, capital markets, or investment banking domain knowledge
No demonstrated SQL Server/Oracle depth or Windows-platform development focus

key_factors.factor: No capital markets / fixed income domain expertise
Strong general engineering and CI/CD/messaging skills
